notes.title: Content upgrade & fixes | Minor v0.1.92.1
notes.content:
NEW
[list]
[*]Added a Hearthstone like item (Soul Village) for all players, so you can teleport back (15 min CD)
[*]Players that gets struck somewhere can now unstuck with the Hearthstone like item (Soul Village)
[/list]

CHANGES
[list]
[*]Players can now also use their Steam Name for their new character
[/list]

FIXES
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that players gain no XP in the Defense skill
[*]Battle Shout Will now only boost players attack when no weapon equiped
[/list]

notes.title: Content upgrade & fixes | Minor v0.1.92
notes.content:
[b]NEW[/b]
[list]
[*] Class customization system with new abilities and buffs
[*] New Brain Panel in the in-game menu
[*] Item and enemy loot tables available in the main menu
[*] Several new items and equipment added
[/list]

[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced the Wretched Eye boss fight to take less time and have more variation
[*] Reduced the defense skill requirement for the Golden and Diamond armor sets
[*] Increased drop rates for Iron Armor pieces from Skeleton Mages and Walking Trees
[*] Increased the number of Jasmin Herbs to make the related quest easier to complete
[*] Decreased the number of Gold and Diamond veins to make them more rare
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where dropping an equipped item didn’t work properly
[*] Fixed a bug where Gold Coins could be converted to Game Tokens after relogging
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented catching fish in the tutorial
[*] Fixed several small bugs that occurred with multiple players online
[*] Fixed several small world-related bugs where players could get stuck
[*] Fixed several small GUI and interface-related bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Content upgrade & fixes | Minor v0.1.8
notes.content:
NEW
Added thick snow in some locations which slows the player movement speed by 50% by walking over

CHANGES
Balanced Wretched Eye Boss by reducing beams that spawn by 10%
Balanced Wretched Eye Boss by doubling cooldown of his shot, but he will do triple shots now

FIXES
Fixed desync bug that sometimes caused to reset some of the players profile data such as level
Fixed bug that caused sometimes action bars not to trigger on activation

notes.title: Performance | Hotfix v0.1.5
notes.content:
CHANGES
[list]
[*] Added option to turn on/off water reflextion which can save 11% on total CPU usage
[*] You can now view in the menu how much CPU usage you can save by turning graphical options off.
[/list]

FIXES
[list]
[*] Reduced total CPU usage for the game by over 30% to ensure 60 FPS on more computers.
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial | Hotfix v0.1.3
notes.content:
[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added progress percentage in tutorial
[*] Made possible to skip tutorial at 60% progress
[*] You no longer need to do the tutorial again when making a new character
[*] You can no longer go to settings or logout when you are in combat
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed unclear dead end in tutorial
[*] Fixed bug that player got struck at bank in tutorial 
[*] Fixed bug that caused the game to crash at the goblin bomber
[/list]
